coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: MB360
record.summary: MB360 is a 188-unit residential building at 701 China Basin St, one of two blocks (Block 5 and Block 11) of a single two-block Mission Bay apartment development originally built by BRE Properties (acquired by Essex Property Trust in 2014), with MVE + Partners as prime architect. DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page both give 2016 as this block's construction-completion year.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8710009), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 265724853) for the name and street address; not a hand trace or plan estimate. Unit count contested across sources (188 vs. 360, possibly two phases/buildings marketed together as MB360/MB360 II); not resolved.

open_questions: Apartment-listing aggregators (Apartments.com, Redfin, ApartmentHomeLiving, among others) give 2014 as this block's construction year, but DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page both give 2016; not resolved which reflects actual first occupancy versus an earlier leasing target that slipped.

Contemporaneous press (SFGate, CBS News San Francisco) reported a 5-alarm fire on March 11, 2014 that destroyed one of the two under-construction MB360 buildings, requiring a rebuild; no source found specifies which of the two street addresses (701 China Basin St, this record, vs. 1200 4th St) was the one destroyed, so it is not asserted here which block the fire affected.
Precise month of this block's actual completion/first occupancy is not sourced beyond the bare Assessor year.
Developer of record beyond BRE Properties/Essex Property Trust, and any subsequent sale history, not researched in this pass.
